import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 1000005;
    static final long INF = 1000000000000000000L;

    static long[] powers = new long[15];
    static List<String>[] digit_lists = new List[7];
    static List<Long>[] sorted_differences = new List[7];
    static long[][] prefix_sums = new long[7][7];

    static long string_to_number(String s) {
        long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            result = result * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long calculate(String prefix, int remaining, long[] counter) {
        if (remaining == -1) return 0;

        int left_size = remaining / 2;
        int right_size = remaining - left_size;
        if (remaining == 1) {
            left_size = 1;
            right_size = 0;
        }

        long total = (int)((counter[0] - string_to_number(prefix) + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
        counter[0]++;

        for (String left : digit_lists[left_size]) {
            String combined = prefix + left;
            total = (int)((total + (-string_to_number(combined) + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD);
            counter[0]++;

            if (left.length() == left_size) {
                long value = string_to_number(combined) % MOD;
                for (int sz = 1; sz <= right_size; ++sz) {
                    long constant = (int)((-value * powers[sz] + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
                    List<Long> vec = sorted_differences[right_size][sz];
                    int pos = lowerBound(vec, MOD - constant);
                    total = (int)((total + (long)vec.size() * constant + prefix_sums[right_size][sz] - (long)MOD * (vec.size() - pos)) % MOD);
                }
                counter[0] += digit_lists[right_size].size();
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < value) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        int N = s.length();

        powers[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) {
            powers[i] = powers[i-1] * 10;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            digit_lists[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= 6; ++j) {
                sorted_differences[i] = new ArrayList<>();
                sorted_differences[i].add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) {
            String num_str = String.valueOf(i);
            String padded = num_str;
            while (padded.length() <= 6) {
                padded = "0" + padded;
                digit_lists[padded.length()].add(padded);
            }
        }

        for (int len = 1; len <= 6; ++len) {
            for (String prev : digit_lists[len-1]) {
                digit_lists[len].add(prev);
            }
            Collections.sort(digit_lists[len]);

            for (int j = 0; j < digit_lists[len].size(); ++j) {
                long val = (j - Integer.parseInt(digit_lists[len].get(j)) + MOD) % MOD;
                sorted_differences[len].get(digit_lists[len].get(j).length()).add(val);
            }

            for (int sz = 1; sz <= len; ++sz) {
                List<Long> list = sorted_differences[len].get(sz);
                Collections.sort(list);
                for (long v : list) {
                    prefix_sums[len][sz] = (prefix_sums[len][sz] + v) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]> queries = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
                if (digit == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && digit == 0) continue;

                current.append((char)('0' + digit));
                if (digit <= s.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    queries.add(new int[]{i, digit, 1, s.length() - i - 1});
                } else {
                    queries.add(new int[]{i, digit, 0, s.length() - i - 2});
                }
                current.setLength(current.length() - 1);
            }
            current.append(s.charAt(i));
            queries.add(new int[]{i, s.charAt(i) - '0', 2, 0});
        }

        long[] counter = {1};
        long answer = 0;

        Collections.sort(queries, (a, b) -> {
            StringBuilder sa = new StringBuilder();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int j = 0; j <= a[0]; ++j) {
                if (a[1] == 2 && j == a[0]) sa.append(s.charAt(j));
                else if (a[2] == 1 && a[1] <= s.charAt(j) - '0') sa.append(a[1]);
                else if (a[2] == 0 && a[1] > s.charAt(j) - '0') sa.append(a[1]);
                else if (j < a[0]) sa.append(s.charAt(j));
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= b[0]; ++j) {
                if (b[1] == 2 && j == b[0]) sb.append(s.charAt(j));
                else if (b[2] == 1 && b[1] <= s.charAt(j) - '0') sb.append(b[1]);
                else if (b[2] == 0 && b[1] > s.charAt(j) - '0') sb.append(b[1]);
                else if (j < b[0]) sb.append(s.charAt(j));
            }
            return sa.toString().compareTo(sb.toString());
        });

        for (int[] q : queries) {
            if (s.charAt(q[0]) == (char)('0' + q[1])) {
                answer = (answer + (-string_to_number(s.substring(0, q[0] + 1)) + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                counter[0]++;
                continue;
            }
            answer = (answer + calculate(s.substring(0, q[0] + 1), q[3], counter)) % MOD;
        }

        answer %= MODD;
        pw.println(answer);
        pw.close();
    }
}
